responses.text: Listen very closely and do as I say. Your life depends on it.

responses.text: There's nothing to talk over. You can strip down and hand over your equipment, or you can die. Will you comply?
I've told you what to do. Strip off your clothes and equipment, or face summary execution. Will you comply?
Take it all off, and hand it to me. Then come inside, and through the door at the rear of the chamber. Paladin Ramos is waiting for you.
He's making a move! Stop him!
